findings.title: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass — Admin Login
findings.description: The admin login form at /admin.php is vulnerable to SQL injection. The username parameter is interpolated directly into a SQL query without parameterisation. Submitting a classic OR-bypass payload logs in as admin without knowing the password, and the flag is printed in the response body.
